scenarios.title: 1. Check evaluation panel heading when evaluation is available
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the evaluation panel shows 'BugsJS review baseline' heading before the patch when evaluation data is available.

scenarios.title: 3. Verify 'Generate Playwright plan' button disabled state without API ready
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the 'Generate Playwright plan' button is disabled when API is not ready and no diff or PR URL is entered, consistent with pre-patch behavior.

scenarios.title: 4. Load example diff and confirm diff content placeholder text
scenarios.purpose: Check that loading example diff inserts expected sample text containing 'Invoice not found' in the unified diff textarea, consistent with pre-patch behavior.

scenarios.title: 5. Validation of evaluation metrics text range display
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that the precision and recall metric texts display the exact numeric ranges before the patch.
